title: inference-domain-fires-its-clock-probes-on-its-own-pulse
intention: The inference_domain device fires its own clock probes (the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database) from its groundloop/pulse.py on each heartbeat, so they run again now that the heartbeat no longer discovers probes/.
why: Since bae622881f03 PROVED (2026-09-30) the heartbeat no longer discovers probes/ folders; it calls only groundloop/pulse.py files. So the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database is dark: the only firing left is one pass at web-server start through bus_client's private GroundLoopDevice, which ticket efb670ff1dd8 removes. That is the lived symptom: the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database checks that the CHECK constraint on inference_calls still refuses an out-of-vocabulary verdict (ticket 6890cf7e4053), and nobody is looking. Akien's group-2 list placed this probe under db_domain; measured 2026-09-30 it berths at cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/, whose ensure_cache() applies the constraint, so by Law 6 the owner that fires it is inference_domain. The other nine probes in that folder are not in group 2 and must NOT fire on the beat.
traces_to: Law 6 and Law 1 via ticket bae622881f03 (PROVED 2026-09-30): the heartbeat calls each groundloop/pulse.py and nothing else, and Akien ruled clock probes are 'tickled by the system device or their owning devices (from the ground loop pulse)'. The owner fires its own watch.
how: Compose the shared tool cairn/tools/base/beat_probes.py built by ticket 32959e65ec5a (do not copy its logic). write cairn/devices/inference_domain/groundloop/pulse.py: a module-level BeatProbes('inference_domain', <this folder>, ['the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database'], bus) and on_pulse(now, context) returning its pulse record. Only the named probes fire; Akien's group-2 list placed this probe under db_domain; measured 2026-09-30 it berths at cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/, whose ensure_cache() applies the constraint, so by Law 6 the owner that fires it is inference_domain. The other nine probes in that folder are not in group 2 and must NOT fire on the beat. The probe files stay where they are, unchanged.
falsifier: Proof cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_groundloop_pulse.py: (1) discovery.pulse_sites() lists cairn/devices/inference_domain/groundloop/pulse.py at class level; (2) the module's BeatProbes names exactly ['the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database'] and each resolves to a Probe; (3) other modules in cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/ are not in its roster; (4) on_pulse(now, {}) with a recording stub bus returns a record whose fired+held entries cover exactly those probes. Live horizon: three consecutive beats of ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/machines/ground_loop/liveness.json list the inference_domain trigger ok. Wrong intent if one of these probes turns out to be event-driven rather than clock-driven.
watchme: none, because the probes being moved ARE the watches (cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database.py), each keeping its own ticket's WATCHME, and whether they fire is read on every beat in the heartbeat's own record ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/machines/ground_loop/liveness.json (the inference_domain trigger's ok flag and pulse record).
assumption_check: (1) the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database is clock probes (Akien's group-2 list, 2026-09-30). (2) The heartbeat calls on_pulse(now, {}) once per 60s beat and holds the module between beats, re-loading it when cairn/devices/inference_domain/groundloop/pulse.py changes, which resets crossing memory; a reset re-pokes a still-true condition once, which is acceptable and matches a loop restart under the old runner. (3) A probe's poke needs a bus; connect_bus(devices=[], beat=False) gives one without beating. (4) The probe files are unchanged; only who fires them moves.
missing_check: (a) This depends on 32959e65ec5a (the shared cairn/tools/base/beat_probes.py); it waits at BUILDME until that is PROVED. (b) Akien's group-2 list placed this probe under db_domain; measured 2026-09-30 it berths at cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/, whose ensure_cache() applies the constraint, so by Law 6 the owner that fires it is inference_domain. The other nine probes in that folder are not in group 2 and must NOT fire on the beat.
builder_check: WHERE: new cairn/devices/inference_domain/groundloop/pulse.py and new cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_groundloop_pulse.py. HOW: from cairn.tools.base.beat_probes import BeatProbes; module level _PROBES = BeatProbes('inference_domain', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], ['the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database'], bus=<lazy connect_bus(devices=[], beat=False)>); on_pulse(now, context) returns _PROBES.on_pulse(now, context). The helper's exact constructor is whatever 32959e65ec5a built: read cairn/tools/base/beat_probes.py first. TESTS use a stub bus and never fire the real triggers (the census/DB reads are slow); assert the roster, not the firing, which the helper's own proof covers. DO NOT move or edit the probe files.

chart_claim.filled_by: CC chart chain (orient fa3cdd354954 .. validate b5883a85329f, each learned)

decisions.text: The proof is written and committed red at 61af2b77: cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_groundloop_pulse.py, the same FAILURES/ok() pattern as cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_groundloop_pulse.py (module-level FAILURES; ok(name, passed, detail) prints '  ok   <name>' or '  RED  <name>' and appends on a fail, never raises; main() returns 1 if FAILURES else 0). It loads the pulse by path inside the teeth and reads FIRER.roster(), FIRER.probes(), FIRER.bind(stub) and on_pulse; the builder writes only the pulse and must not edit the proof.

Create cairn/devices/inference_domain/groundloop/pulse.py (no __init__.py; the heartbeat loads it by path) mirroring cairn/devices/cairn/groundloop/pulse.py: a docstring naming this ticket; 'from pathlib import Path'; 'from cairn.tools.base.beat_probes import BeatProbes'; NAMES = ('the_verdict_vocabulary_is_refused_at_the_database',); def _bus(): from cairn.tools.bus_client import reach; return reach()  (imported lazily, called with no devices because no named probe asks over the bus; BeatProbes calls it on the first beat, never at import); FIRER = BeatProbes('inference_domain', Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent, list(NAMES), bus=_bus); def on_pulse(now, context=None) -> dict: return FIRER.on_pulse(now, context).

After the build commit the running heartbeat reloads on its own (Triggers holds pulse modules by mtime). Read ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/machines/ground_loop/liveness.json on three consecutive beats (last_run advancing each time, one pid): the 'inference_domain' class-level trigger is listed ok true each time. 'cairn groundloop status' prints the same record.
